stock.description: Zhongliang Holdings Group Company Limited, established in 1993 and based in Shanghai, People's Republic of China, is a diversified entity primarily focused on property development throughout the PRC. The firm's activities encompass the creation, operation, and stewardship of commercial real estate ventures, all marketed under the "Zhongliang" designation. Furthermore, it offers specialized management advisory services.
